headline: RBC Capital Maintains Sector Perform on Martin Marietta Materials, Lowers Price Target to $610
summary: RBC Capital  analyst Anthony Codling   maintains Martin Marietta Materials (NYSE:MLM) with a Sector Perform and lowers the price target from $615 to $610.
